test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym to replace the underlined word.

The smoke was bothering me, and I didn't want to *__ruin__ *the party for all of you, so I simply walked home.
solution:
The correct answer is **despoil**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The italicized word in the given sentence is '**ruin**'.
 
• The most appropriate synonym for '**ruin**' is '**despoil**'.
 
• Let's understand the meaning of the other options.
 
 
• ​**Fix**- to repair something.
 
• **Revamp**- to change something in order to make it more attractive.
 
• **Recover**- to become well again after you have been ill.
